transcript.content: Hello, it's good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Nice to meet you too. Um, well, I guess I'm here because I've been having a really hard time at work lately. I'm a hairstylist, and... my hands just feel like they’re moving through glue. 

Even doing basic things, like sectioning hair or mixing color, it just takes me forever now. It's gotten to the point where people at the salon have started noticing that I’m just a lot slower than I used to be. So, yeah, that's mainly why I needed to come in.
Have you been feeling depressed lately?
Yeah, I have. Um, most days I just wake up with this... this heavy, flat sadness right in my chest. It just feels like there's no point in trying to build the life I was planning for myself.
Have you ever had a period when you felt unusually high, energized, or wired?
No, um... not really. I don't think I've ever felt like that. Honestly, feeling energized or wired is kind of the exact opposite of how I usually feel. So, no, I haven't had a time like that.
Have you been told you have a thyroid problem?
No, I haven't. I mean, my regular doctor hasn't ever mentioned anything about my thyroid being an issue.
Before this current period, have you ever had another time in your life when you felt depressed like this for days or weeks at a time?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had regular bad days before, just like anyone, but never anything that lasted for weeks at a time like this. This is really the first time it's been this heavy and constant.
Have you noticed any tremor in your hands?
No, my hands don't shake. I work as a hairstylist, so I think I'd definitely notice if I had a tremor since I'm holding scissors all day. But no, they're steady.
Have you had a head injury recently?
No, I haven't hit my head or anything like that. I haven't been in any accidents or had any kind of injury recently.
Have you started any new medication or drug recently?
No, I haven't started taking anything new. I don't really take any medications, and I haven't used any other drugs either.
Have you been eating less than usual lately?

Yeah, I have. I've been... well, I've been skipping meals without really meaning to. I'll just go about my day and then realize at night that I only had coffee and maybe a few bites of something. And, um, I have noticed my clothes have gotten a bit looser lately because of it.
Have other people commented that you seem slowed down in your movements or speech lately?

Yeah, they have. Um, especially at work. It's like my hands feel like they’re moving through glue. Even just doing basic stuff, like sectioning hair or mixing color... it just takes me forever now. So, yeah, people have definitely started noticing and pointing out that I’m just a lot slower than I used to be.
Have you had thoughts about killing yourself?

No, I don't have a plan to hurt myself or anything like that. But... I do get these thoughts sometimes. Like, it would just be easier if I went to sleep and didn't wake up. Then nobody would have to deal with me anymore.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I have. I used to really enjoy chatting with my clients and helping out the newer stylists at the salon. And outside of work, I used to go hiking with my friends a lot. But now... I just mostly keep my head down. I've been avoiding people, really, because I just don't have that spark in me anymore. I just don't have the interest to do any of it right now.
Have you been hearing voices that other people can't hear?

Yeah, I actually have. Um... sometimes when I’m just sweeping up the floor or rinsing out the color bowls at work, I hear a woman’s voice. It usually sounds like it's coming from over by the shampoo stations. She just keeps saying that I’m ruining everything. But... it happens even when the salon is totally empty, or when there's nobody anywhere close by. So, yeah, I know it's not a real person standing there.
Does the voice say things that fit with feeling guilty or worthless, like telling you that you’re a bad person or that everything is your fault?

No, not really. I mean, she says I'm ruining everything, like I mentioned, but she doesn't specifically say I'm a bad person or anything like that. It's more just... telling me I'm messing things up at the salon, not really about me being worthless in general.
Did the voice first start after you became depressed this time?

No, actually... it started before that. Before the depression really took over, there was a stretch of several weeks where I was still getting up and functioning more normally. I was still going to work and everything, but I was already hearing the voice then. And during that same time, I was also feeling really sure that someone at the salon was interfering with my schedule. So, yeah, it started before I got this down.
Was there ever a period of at least two weeks when you were hearing the voice even though you were not feeling depressed?

Yeah, exactly. Like I was just saying, it was a stretch of several weeks. Before the depression really took over, I was getting up and functioning pretty normally. I wasn't feeling down yet. But... I was already hearing the voice during that time. And I was also dealing with that feeling I mentioned, being so sure someone at the salon was messing with my schedule. So, yeah, it was definitely more than two weeks where I wasn't depressed but still hearing her.
Since these problems began, has depression been present for most of the time overall?

Yeah, definitely. Looking back at this whole thing, I've spent most of the time feeling really depressed and just... weighed down by it all. There were some shorter stretches where the sadness wasn't as bad, but overall, the depression has been there for most of it.
